notes: LUMADOCK LTD, company 15844051, is Active at Companies House, was incorporated on 17 July 2024 and was named LIFEINCLOUD LTD until 27 March 2026; its last accounts run to 31 July 2025 and its confirmation statement was filed on 16 July 2026, so it is trading. Two things do not line up: the site says the company is 'based in London W1S 1HN' while the register gives a Harrow HA3 8DP registered office, which is a formation-agent address, and the seller operates Romanian infrastructure with a +40 phone number. None of that makes it NATKVM, which was dissolved while still selling; it makes it a two-year-old company with a renamed history, which is worth knowing before paying a year up front. The price is also a 17% discount off USD 5.99, so the renewal is over the line.
